description: Implementation of the MockFileStream class for testing file stream operations, including methods for seek, read, write, flush, and callback handling within the net::testing namespace.

classes.name: MockFileStream
classes.description: A mock implementation of a file stream used for testing, supporting seek, read, write, flush, and callback control.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified offset in the file stream, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the stream, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: ThrottleCallbacks
methods.description: Throttles callback invocation, delaying callback execution.

methods.name: ReleaseCallbacks
methods.description: Releases throttled callbacks, executing any pending callbacks.

methods.name: DoCallback
methods.description: Executes a callback with a result, considering throttling state.

methods.name: DoCallback64
methods.description: Executes a 64-bit callback with a result, considering throttling state.

methods.name: ErrorCallback
methods.description: Handles error callback, posting error asynchronously if needed.

methods.name: ErrorCallback64
methods.description: Handles 64-bit error callback, posting error asynchronously if needed.
